subject: Add `availability_zone` to the HELLO command history (#1524)
reason: The change is documentation-only: it adds a history entry for HELLO in src/commands/hello.json and the generated src/commands.def, bumping the history count in the command table to match the new array length. It alters no command behaviour, reply, config handling or server logic — only the text returned by COMMAND DOCS — so there is no risky path to exercise and no scenario is needed.
